hypotheses.justification: This instance is redundant. Mathlib has the global instance `AlgebraicClosure.isAlgClosed : IsAlgClosed (AlgebraicClosure k)` (Mathlib/FieldTheory/IsAlgClosed/AlgebraicClosure.lean:203), and it applies for any `[Field K]`. The only place the statement needs it is `LangSetup Tag.E6 (AlgebraicClosure K) p`, whose definition takes `[Field L] [IsAlgClosed L]`. Without the binder, instance resolution finds the global instance there. `IsAlgClosed` is a Prop, so there is no instance-mismatch issue. The binder sits after `hpq1` and before `S`, and none of the earlier hypotheses need it. The proof (destructuring `S`, `exists_rigid_frame_E6_two`, `setupRigid_of_frame`) only uses the instance through typeclass resolution, so it keeps working with the global instance. The statement stays true and provable after deleting the binder.
